mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY p.product_id DESC
SELECT p.*, c.category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (product_name, category_id, price, stock, pic, content, status) VALUES (#{productName}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{pic}, #{content}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = stock - #{quantity} WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND stock >= #{quantity}
